description: Samuel slipped while getting out of bed unassisted, resulting in a fractured right femur. He was immediately placed on prescribed bed rest.
After several days of prescribed bed rest, Samuel showed early signs of mild confusion, consistent with his Senile Dementia being aggravated by reduced mobility and routine disruption.
Samuel's physiotherapy session went well, with slight improvement in leg mobility since the femur fracture.
Samuel attempted to stand up unsupervised to reach for a glass of water, putting strain on his healing femur and requiring staff intervention to prevent a fall.
